description: 国王印度 E61 — d线争夺与车占中心格

intro.popup_en: Contesting the d-File, Lesson 4: Once the d-file opens, both sides fight for it. Black uses the file to establish a knight on d4, then brings a rook through the file to occupy the same central square. Every square on an open file can become valuable.
intro.popup:
d线争夺与车占中心 第4课

d线开放后，双方争夺d线！

黑方利用开放线：
Nd4强力外站！
车借d线进入d4中心！

开放线上的每个格子都是宝地！

outro.popup_en: When the d-file opens, both sides contest it. Black first establishes a knight on d4, then uses Rxd4 to bring a rook onto the fourth rank. The pattern is knight to the outpost, rook behind it: coordinate the pieces to exploit the open file.
outro.popup:
d线争夺小结
✅ d线开放→双方争夺
✅ Nd4外站：开放线中心格
✅ Rxd4：车借d线进入第4行

核心公式：
开放线→马占强格→车跟进
马前车后，协同利用开放线！

moves.popup_en: ...Nd4! Black's knight occupies a golden outpost on the open file. The square is both central and difficult to challenge.
moves.popup:
Nd4！黑马跳入d4！
d4是开放线上的
黄金外站！

moves.popup_en: Bxd4 exchanges the knight because White cannot allow it to remain on d4 indefinitely. Black's rook is ready to exploit the file.
moves.popup:
Bxd4白方兑换
无法让马久守d4
黑方杀机将现身！

moves.popup_en: ...Rxd4! Black's rook enters the center through the open d-file. This is the power of the file: after the exchange, the rook immediately occupies a strong fourth-rank square.
moves.popup:
Rxd4！黑车进入d4！
车借开放线占领d4中心！

这就是d线的力量：
兑换后车立即进入强格！

moves.popup_en: Rd1! White also claims the d-file. Both sides now contest the file with their rooks.
moves.popup:
Rd1！白车抢d线！
对应黑车Rxd4
双方在d线展开争夺！

moves.popup_en: ...Ne8 reroutes the knight and protects Black's position.

moves.popup_en: Nb5! White's knight threatens d6 and c7, applying pressure.
moves.popup:
Nb5！白马威胁！
指向d6/c7，施加压力

moves.popup_en: ...Rd7 defends d7 and blocks the knight's entry routes. The open file has given both sides' rooks and knights maximum activity.
moves.popup:
Rd7黑车防守d7

局面总结：
开放线让双方车马
都获得最大活跃度！
